info.title: hauswart API
info.description: Versioned JSON API of hauswart, used by the web app, the mobile app and integrations. Errors share one envelope: `{ error: { code, message, details? } }`. Cookie-authenticated requests that change state must send an `Origin` header equal to the app origin and `Content-Type: application/json`; bearer requests are exempt.

get.summary: Whether first-run setup is still open
get.description: `needsSetup` is true until the first administrator account exists. `tokenRequired` is true while setup is open and the server was started with `HAUSWART_SETUP_TOKEN`: the setup request must then carry `setupToken`.

post.summary: Create the first administrator and sign in
post.description: Only works while no user exists (409 `setup_complete` afterwards). When the server runs with `HAUSWART_SETUP_TOKEN`, `setupToken` must match it (403 `forbidden`). Starts a browser session (sets the session cookie).

post.summary: Sign in with a username and password
post.description: Starts a browser session (sets the session cookie). Failed attempts are rate limited per user and client address.

get.summary: The calling user, how they authenticated and their effective scopes

patch.summary: Update the calling user's display name or language

post.summary: Exchange a username and password for a device token
post.description: Issues a `mobile` bearer token (scopes read, write, docs:write, costs:write; valid for 90 days). The token is shown once. Failed attempts share the login rate limit.

delete.summary: Revoke the token used for this request

get.summary: List the calling user's API tokens
get.description: Never includes token values or hashes.

post.summary: Create an API token for an integration
post.description: The plaintext token is in the response and never shown again. Scopes cannot exceed the caller's own.

delete.summary: Revoke one of the calling user's API tokens
delete.description: Other users' tokens are not visible: 404.

patch.summary: Change a user's role, name, cost share or password
patch.description: A password reset ends the user's sessions and revokes all of their live API tokens. Demoting an administrator revokes their tokens that hold the `admin` scope. The last administrator cannot be demoted.

post.description: The slug is derived from the name unless given.

delete.description: Assets and tasks in the room stay and lose their room.

get.description: Filter by kind, room or a search text. Archived assets are left out unless includeArchived=true.

post.description: Gets a random qrSlug for QR deep links. The slug is derived from the name unless given.

get.summary: Look up an asset by its QR slug

patch.description: Set archived to true to archive, false to restore.

delete.description: Tasks of the asset stay and lose the link. Archive instead to keep it.

get.summary: List tasks with their due state
get.description: Ordered overdue first, then by due date. assignee=me or a user id matches the current assignee.

post.description: The trigger is validated by the due-date engine; the first due date is computed before the response.

post.summary: Preview what a trigger would give
post.description: Evaluates the trigger as if it had never been completed. Nothing is stored. POST for the body; needs only read access.

get.summary: Get a task with preparations and recent completions

patch.description: Re-evaluates the task. archived=true archives, false restores.

delete.description: Removes the task with its completions, preparations and notifications. Archive instead to keep the history.

post.description: Returns the completion and the re-evaluated task. A repeated idempotencyKey returns the first completion with status 200. Browser sessions are attributed as manual (or qr when sent); API tokens by their kind (mcp, ha, otherwise api) and their source field is ignored. Linked spare parts are taken out of stock. With serviceLog the work is also logged on the task's asset (400 for a task without an asset); the entry comes back as serviceLog.

post.summary: Skip the current occurrence of a task
post.description: Like complete, but recorded as skipped: the next occurrence follows without counting as done.

post.summary: Hide a task until a date
post.description: until must be after today; null ends the snooze. Snoozed tasks send no notifications.

get.summary: List the preparations of a task

post.summary: Add a preparation to a task

post.description: For the occurrence the task shows now unless occurrenceKey is given. Repeating it is not an error.

delete.description: Any household member may undo within 7 days of the completion being recorded; the task goes back to its previous due date. Undoing twice is not an error.

get.description: Overdue, today, this week, later (60 days) and signal-based tasks, relevant preparations and the last completions. openDefects: defects that need attention, by deadline. expiringWarranties: warranties ending within 90 days or ended at most 30 days ago. orderNow: parts to order now (same items as GET /parts/order-now).
By completion date between from and to (default: the last 90 days, at most 800 days).
Own and household-wide notifications. Text is a message key plus params, rendered in the reader's language.

post.description: Other users' notifications are not visible: 404.

get.summary: The household's name, settings and time zone

patch.summary: Change the household's name, handover date or settings

get.summary: Names of everyone in the household
get.description: Id and display name only, for assignee pickers and activity lines. Open to every authenticated caller.

post.summary: Revoke all of a user's API tokens
post.description: Revokes every live API token (mobile, integration, MCP) of the user, e.g. after a leaked token. Browser sessions are not affected. Returns how many tokens were revoked.

get.description: Filter by kind, emergency flag or a search text over name, company, e-mail and phone. Sorted by sort order, then name.

post.description: externalSource and externalRef link the contact to a record in another system; the pair is unique.

get.summary: Get a contact with the assets it is linked to

delete.description: Links to assets are removed; service log entries and defects that named the contact keep their text and lose the link.

post.summary: Link a contact to an asset
post.description: A contact can be linked to an asset once per role; repeating it is a conflict.

delete.summary: Unlink a contact from an asset

get.description: Filter by a search text, by linked asset or task, or to parts below their minimum stock. Archived parts are left out unless includeArchived=true.

post.description: A starting stock above zero is booked as a movement. The currency defaults to the household's.

get.description: For each task with linked parts: the parts whose stock (plus what is on order) does not cover the quantity the task needs plus the minimum stock, once today has reached the order-by date (needed-by date minus the part's lead time). Sorted by order-by date.

get.summary: Get a spare part with its links and recent movements

patch.description: Stock is changed with the stock endpoint, which records a movement.

delete.description: Links to assets and tasks and the movement history go with it; preparations that named the part lose the link. Archive to keep the history.

post.description: `used` takes stock out (negative delta), `bought` brings it in (positive delta) and ends a pending order, `correction` does either. Stock cannot go below zero. Completing a task that has the part linked books a `used` movement by itself.

get.summary: Stock movements of a part, newest first

post.description: Records the order time and quantity (default: the reorder quantity); qty 0 clears the order. Booking the stock as bought clears it too.

post.summary: Link a spare part to an asset

delete.summary: Unlink a spare part from an asset

post.summary: Link a spare part to a task
post.description: Completing the task takes qty of the part out of stock; undoing the completion puts it back.

patch.summary: Change the quantity a task uses

delete.summary: Unlink a spare part from a task

get.summary: Recent service log entries across all assets
get.description: Newest first; filter by asset, kind or a date range.

get.summary: Service log of an asset, newest first

get.description: Defects that still need attention come first, by deadline (none last), then by number. Filter by status (or active=true for open, reported and in progress), severity, room, asset or a search text.

post.description: Without deadlineDate the deadline is the household's handover date plus its defect deadline months, when a handover date is set. A deadline creates a reminder task.

get.description: An A4 document: a table of the defects (filtered by status and room) and the history of each one. Language follows the caller's account.

get.summary: Get a defect with its events

patch.description: The status has its own endpoint. Changing the deadline updates the reminder task.

delete.description: Events, comments and the reminder task go with it. Close a defect (fixed, rejected) to keep the history.

post.summary: Change the status of a defect
post.description: From open, reported or in progress to any other status; fixed and rejected defects can only be reopened. Every change is written to the defect's events. Fixed and rejected archive the reminder task, reopening restores it.
Adds a correspondence entry (a letter sent or received) to the defect's history. Remarks use the generic comments endpoints.

get.summary: Events and comments of a defect, oldest first

get.description: Assets with a warranty date, by the day the warranty ends (the later of warrantyUntil and warrantyExtendedUntil). Status: expired once that day has passed, expiring within 90 days, otherwise valid.

get.summary: Comments on a task, defect, asset or other entity
get.description: Oldest first. Deleted comments stay in the thread with an empty body and deleted=true.

post.description: The other household members involved get an in-app notification.

patch.description: Only its author may edit, at any time; the edit time is recorded. Deleted comments cannot be edited.

delete.description: Its author or an administrator may delete. The comment stays in the thread as deleted; deleting twice is not an error.

get.description: Pinned hints first, then by sort order and creation time.

post.summary: Add a care hint to an asset
post.description: A hint is a tip, rule or warning for using or caring for the device. It may link a recurring task and carry a signal reaction (stored; an adapter carries it out). Without sortOrder it goes to the end.

get.description: Filter by asset, kind or reactive=true (hints with a signal reaction). Archived assets' hints are left out.

patch.description: Reorder by changing sortOrder; pin with pinned.

delete.description: Its comments go with it; a linked task stays.

get.description: Pinned first, then by sortOrder and title; with q, best match first. q is a full-text search over title and text (secret blocks excluded); archived pages are never found by it. Archived pages are left out unless includeArchived=true.

post.description: The markdown is rendered before the response (member and guest HTML, plain text, headings). 400 `invalid_request` with `details.code` `too_large` (over 200 KB) or `too_complex` (rendering exceeded its time limit) when it cannot be rendered. Writes revision 1. `attachment:<id>` links and images resolve to attachments, `[[slug]]` and `[[slug|label]]` to `/docs/<slug>`.

post.summary: Render markdown for the editor preview
post.description: Renders as a member sees the page (secret blocks shown). Nothing is stored. Same size and complexity limits as saving; rate limited per user (429 `rate_limited`).

get.description: Markdown source, rendered HTML for members (secret blocks included), headings, revision number and backlinks.

patch.summary: Edit, move, pin or archive a page
patch.description: `rev` is the revision the client edited; when the page has moved on the answer is 409 `conflict` with `details.currentRev`. Every successful save writes a revision (the last 50 are kept). Changing the slug does not rewrite `[[links]]` in other pages.

delete.description: Removes the page with its revisions and attachments. Archive instead to keep it.

get.summary: Revision history of a page, newest first
get.description: The last 50 saved states (no markdown; fetch one for that).

get.summary: One saved state of a page, with its markdown

post.summary: Make an earlier revision the current one
post.description: Saves the title and markdown of that revision as a new revision (history is never rewritten, so nothing is lost). Returns the page.

get.summary: Search pages, assets, rooms, tasks, defects, contacts, parts and care hints
get.description: Full-text search, best match first; every word is matched as a prefix. Archived pages, assets, tasks and parts are not searched. Searched fields: titles and names, plus page text, device data and notes, descriptions, a defect's location, a contact's company and notes (never phone, e-mail or address), a part's number, supplier and notes, a hint's text. Pages are searched without their secret blocks, and every other free text is cut off at the first `:::` block when it mentions a secret, so a snippet never contains secret text. Snippets are plain text. `url` is the app path of the hit.

post.summary: Upload a file to an owner
post.description: multipart/form-data with `file`, `ownerType`, `ownerId`, optional `caption` and `guestVisible`. JPEG, PNG and WebP images are re-encoded (metadata removed, orientation applied, longest side capped) and get a thumbnail; PDFs are stored as uploaded. At most 25 MiB. Errors are 400/413/415 `invalid_request` with `details.code`: `empty`, `too_large` (413), `unsupported_type` (415), `unsupported_heic` (415), `corrupt_image`, `image_too_large` (413); an unknown or unsupported owner is a field error on `ownerId` or `ownerType`. Attaching to a page needs the `docs:write` scope.

get.summary: List the attachments of an owner
get.description: Oldest first.

patch.summary: Change the caption or the guest visibility
patch.description: Pages that embed the attachment are rendered again. Needs `docs:write` when the owner is a page.

delete.description: Removes the row and, when nothing else uses the stored file, the file (a file stored less than a minute ago is kept until the next cleanup). An asset photo pointing at it is cleared. Pages that embed it are rendered again. Needs `docs:write` when the owner is a page.

get.description: Streams the stored bytes with their detected content type: images and PDFs inline, `?download=1` as a download. Sent with `nosniff`, a restrictive CSP, an ETag (`If-None-Match` answers 304) and `Cache-Control: private, max-age=31536000, immutable`. Works for `` with the session cookie.
480 px WebP; 404 for attachments without a thumbnail (PDFs). Same headers as the content endpoint.

get.summary: The caller's push preferences and notification targets
get.description: Own settings only. `pushStages` are the kinds of notification that reach the phone (the in-app list always has all of them); notifications arriving between `quietStart` and `quietEnd` (household time zone) are held back and sent afterwards. A target is a notify service of the connected smart-home system.

put.summary: Replace the caller's push preferences and targets
put.description: Replaces preferences and the whole list of targets (at most 10). Target names are lowercase letters, digits and underscores.

get.summary: The integrations and their connection status
get.description: One entry per kind: the household's connection, or the caller's own for kinds each person connects. Never contains the access token; the address and settings of a household connection are shown to administrators only.

put.description: Household-level kinds need an administrator. A new connection needs the token, and so does a changed address (a stored token is never sent to another host); a blank token keeps the stored one. The status resets to `unknown` until the next check.

delete.description: Household-level kinds need an administrator. Tasks, assets and hints that refer to the system keep working without live data.

post.description: Calls the system once and records the outcome as the connection's status. An unreachable system is a normal answer (`ok: false` with an error code and message), not an HTTP error. Household-level kinds need an administrator.

get.summary: Entities of the connected system (entity picker)
get.description: From a short-lived cache of the system's states. Filter by `q` (id or name) and `domain`. 404 when the kind has no connection or no such operation; 502 `upstream_error` when the system does not answer.

get.summary: Notify services of the connected system
get.description: Candidates for a person's notification targets.

get.summary: Devices of the connected system that no asset represents yet
get.description: Suggestions for the inventory: manufacturer, model, name and area of every enabled device that matches no asset (by external reference, name, or manufacturer and model). Creating an asset from one is a separate call with `externalSource` and `externalRef`.

post.summary: A button on a pushed notification was tapped
post.description: Called by the smart-home system when someone taps "done" on a notification: `{"action": "HW_DONE_<token>"}` with an API token of kind `ha` and the `ha:action` scope. The token resolves to the task occurrence the notification was about and to the person it was sent to; the completion is attributed to that person (source `notification`), not to the calling token. 404 for an unknown action, 410 `gone` when the token expired, its task is gone, the occurrence was settled otherwise, or the first completion was undone. Tapping again (or a retried request) answers 200 with the first completion and `replayed: true`.

cookieAuth.name: hauswart_session
cookieAuth.description: Browser session cookie set by login or setup.

bearerAuth.description: API token (`hw_...`) from `POST /api/v1/auth/token` or `POST /api/v1/tokens`. Listed scopes are required.
